lines: Nine bays, six bins, and a floor you could race a horse down.
It holds a year of this parish. Never once been full and never once been empty.
That is what a contract does. My father had one or the other every single year.
Every load in, every load out, and a signature against both.
The ledgers go back before the line. You can find the year it came by the thickness.
One winter a spine goes from a finger to a hand. Nothing here was the same after.
